A snapshot of the values for an entry. 
   * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public Editor edit() throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Returns an editor for this snapshot's entry, or null if either the
     * entry has changed since this snapshot was created or if another edit
     * is in progress.

methods.name: public Source getSource(int index)
methods.comment: Returns the unbuffered stream with the value for {@code index}.

methods.name: public long getLength(int index)
methods.comment: Returns the byte length of the value for {@code index}.
